lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, last night we faced certain things
The corners of the heart
Yeah
I lay my blind spots at your feet
Down in the quiet dark
I woke before the morning light
Water falling
And the tears the same
So tired of this broken world
So tired of the shame
No words of form I couldn't speak
I felt myself begin to fall
Yeah, I'm falling
I was breaking in your arms But I was saved there
Crying from the deepest part And you were right there
My thirsty soul cried out your name
I saw you in the distance
And I yearn, I long for your embrace
White robes in a far off light
I could barely stand
Everywhere I turned I saw the reaching of your hand
I wrapped my arms around the one who gave away his all
I kissed the holes within your hands
I couldn't bear what they've done to you
The bursting of my heart, the cry
My soul longs for you
I watched you lift it high until the sky grew dark
I wept like I was standing there, helpless in my love
You gave your final breath, the moment stood still
In the silence of your death, I wept
I cried, my soul yearned as I watched you die
You said the power of your rising
Is living now in me
I was breaking in your arms
But I was safe there
And now I know I never leave
Because you're everywhere
Well, I'm living, breathing inside of you, you are alive in me.
Hmm, hmm, hmm
Hmm, hmm, hmm
